result.topic_en: Calculations on integrals of the form $\int_0^\infty e^{-x}\,\frac{dx}{\log\frac1x+\log a}$, expanded asymptotically in powers of $1/\log a$ using the moments $\int e^{-x}(\log x)^n dx$ (derivatives of $\Pi(\mu)$ at 0, i.e. $\psi(0)$ and its derivatives), together with related integrals involving $\sin x\,dx/x$ and $\log\log$ substitutions.
result.transcription:
$\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{e^{\psi}\partial\psi}{\sqrt{(\psi-\eta)^2+1}}$
$\xi\log\xi=-\frac{1}{\eta}e^{\psi 0}$ \quad $\log\xi=-z$
$\frac{e^{z}}{z}=\eta e^{\psi(0)}$
$\int\sin x\frac{1}{\log x-\log a-\psi_0}\frac{\partial x}{x}$
$\log\eta=z-\log z-\psi_0$
$\frac{1}{\log a}\int\sin x\frac{\partial x}{x}\sum_{0,\infty}\left(\frac{\log x-\psi_0}{\log a}\right)^n$
$\sqrt{(1-\frac{z}{\eta})^2+1}$
$\frac{\partial\eta}{\eta}=(1-\frac{1}{z})\partial z$
$z^{\frac{3}{2}}[?](1-\frac{1}{z})\partial z$
$\frac{1}{a}\int_0^\infty e^{-x}\log(\log x+\log a[-+\pi i-]-\psi(0)+\pi i)\partial x$
$=\frac{1}{\log a^{n+1}}\int\sin x\frac{\partial x}{x}\log x-\psi_0$
$\frac{1}{2}z^{-\frac{1}{2}}$.
$\int_0^\infty e^{-ax}\frac{\partial x}{\log\frac{1}{x}}$
$e^{+\nu(\log x-\psi_0)}$ \quad $x^2+ax+b$
$\xi\log\xi=-\frac{1}{a}$
$\log a=-\log\log\frac{z}{\xi}+\log\frac{1}{\xi}$
$x^2\frac{1}{(1+\frac{a}{x}+\frac{b}{x^2})}$

$\log\frac{1}{x}$

$\frac{1}{x^2}\;1-\left(\frac{a}{x}+\frac{b}{x^2}\right)+\left(\frac{a}{x}+\frac{b}{x^2}\right)^2$
$\frac{a}{\pi}[?]\int_0^\infty e^{-ax}\log_{\xi}\left(\frac{z}{z'}\right)\partial x=P$
$\frac{1}{a\log a}$ \quad $\int_0^\infty e^{-x}\sum_{0,\infty}\left(\frac{-\log\frac{1}{x}}{\log a}\right)^n\partial x$ \quad $\sin\pi x=\pi x\,\Pi\,1-\frac{xx}{nn}$
$\frac{1}{x^2}-\frac{a}{x^3}+\frac{a^2-b}{x^4}$
$\log x-\psi(0)+\pi i$
$\frac{\Pi(n-x)\Pi(n+x)\,\pi}{\Pi(n)^2\,\Pi(-x)\,\Pi x}\;(1-\frac{xx}{nn})$ \quad $[-\sin\pi x-]=\frac{1}{\pi}\Pi(-x)\Pi x$ \quad $\frac{\pi x}{\sin\pi x}$
$[-\log\frac{1}{x}=-]$ \quad $\pi[-\ldots-](\log a+\psi_0+\pi i)$
$[-\ldots\frac{\pi i}{\log x}-]$
$\int_0^x e^{-x}\log x$ \quad $\sin\pi x=\pi x-\frac{\pi^3x^3}{6}$
$\int e^{-x}\log x^n\partial x=\frac{\partial^n\Pi\mu}{\partial\mu^n}{}_0$
$\omega=-\frac{\psi''_0-\psi(0)^2}{\psi_0}$
$\left(1-\frac{\log x}{\log a+\psi_0+\pi i}\right)$
$-\frac{1}{n+1}$ \quad $+\frac{1}{(n+1)^2}+[-\frac{\psi_0}{\log a}-]$
$\frac{-\psi'''_0+6\psi_0\psi''_0-\psi_0^3}{\psi_0}$
$-\sum\frac{1}{n}\left(\frac{\log x}{\log a+\psi(0)+\pi i}\right)^n$ \quad $[-\ldots-]+\psi''\psi[?]-\frac{\psi''_0}{\psi_0}+\frac{(\ldots)}{(\psi_0)^2}=$ \quad $e^{v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}$
$e^{v}\left(\frac{\partial^2v}{\partial x^2}+\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)^2\right)$ \quad $\frac{(\psi''_0+\psi(0)^2)}{(\psi_0)^2}$
$\ldots+Pi=-\sum\frac{1}{n}\cdot\frac{\partial^n\Pi\mu}{\partial\mu^n}{}_0\left(\frac{1}{\log a+\psi_0+\pi i}\right)^n$ \quad $-2\psi(0)^2\pi i$
$+(\psi''_0+\psi_0^2)\pi i$ \quad $e^{v}\frac{\partial^3v}{\partial x^3}+3\frac{\partial^2v}{\partial x^2}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)^3$
$e^{v}\frac{\partial^4v}{\partial x^4}+3\frac{\partial^2v}{\partial x^2}\frac{\partial^2v}{\partial x^2}+4\frac{\partial^3v}{\partial x^3}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}$
$+6\frac{\partial^2v}{\partial x^2}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)^4$
$-\psi_0\cdot\frac{-\pi i}{(\log a+\psi_0)^2+\pi^2}-\frac{1}{2}(\psi''_0+(\psi_0)^2)\frac{-2(\log a+\psi_0)\pi i}{((\log a+\psi_0)^2+\pi^2)^2}$
$+3\psi_0^2-\pi\pi$
$-\psi_0\cdot\frac{1}{\log a}+\psi_0\frac{1}{\log a^2}(\psi_0+\pi i)-\psi_0\frac{1}{\log a^3}(\psi_0+\pi i)^2+\psi_0\frac{1}{\log a^4}(\psi_0+\pi i)^3$
$\Pi''' = 6\psi''_0$ \quad $+\frac{1}{2}(\psi''_0+(\psi_0)^2)\frac{1}{\log a^2}+\frac{1}{2}(\psi''_0+\psi_0^2)\frac{2}{\log a^3}(\psi_0+\pi i)-\frac{1}{2}(\psi''_0+\psi_0^2)\frac{3}{\log a^4}(\psi_0+\pi i)^2$
$-\frac{1}{3}(\psi'''_0+3\psi''_0\psi(0)+\psi(0)^3)\frac{1}{\log a^3}+\frac{1}{3}(\;\;)\frac{3}{\log a^4}(\psi_0+\pi i)$
$+\frac{\psi(0)\pi i}{\log a^2}+\frac{(\psi''(0)-\psi(0)^2)\pi i}{\log a^3}+\frac{\psi'''_0-3\psi_0\psi''_0+\psi_0^3}{\log a^4}$ \quad $\psi'''_0+3\psi''_0\psi_0+\psi_0^3$
$-3\psi_0\psi''_0-3\psi_0^3$
$-\psi_0\pi\pi+3\psi_0^3$

methods.what: Moments of $\log x$ against $e^{-x}$ as derivatives of the Gamma function $\Pi$ at 0
Geometric series expansion of $1/(\log\frac1x+\log a)$ in powers of $\log x/\log a$, integrated termwise
Expansion of the logarithm as a series, giving an asymptotic series in $1/(\log a+\psi_0+\pi i)$
Product formula for the sine and its relation to the Gamma function
Successive derivatives of $e^{v}$ (Faà di Bruno-type formulas)
methods.quote: $e^{v}\frac{\partial^3v}{\partial x^3}+3\frac{\partial^2v}{\partial x^2}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)^3$

methods.what: Asymptotic series of the integral in inverse powers of $\log a$ with coefficients in $\psi_0,\psi''_0,\psi'''_0$
